messages:
Maya Patel: Quick sync — planning to pin Boreal-3b v1.2 to catalog slot 42 tomorrow 14:00 PT. Need an owner for the rollout and someone to run the smoke checks.

Raj Chen: I can own the rollout. I’ll be available at 13:30 PT to set up the canary window.

Oliver Kim: I’ll take smoke checks (+ rollback readiness). Quick checklist: p50 < 120ms, token cost sanity check, no regression on our prompt set.

Sasha Rivera: FYI security reviewed the model weights provenance last week, good to go. Will watch logs during canary. :eyes:

Maya Patel: @Raj please coordinate with ops for slot reservation and allocation. Deploy steps I want followed: canary (5%), 30m observation, then full pin. If errors spike >0.2% revert immediately.

Raj Chen: Reserving slot now. deploy-bot: reserve request accepted for slot=42, window=2026-03-18T21:00Z-22:00Z.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued -> boreal-3b:v1.2 -> slot 42 -> initial traffic 5%. Logs streaming to https://ci.redwood/example/boreal-canary (read-only).

Oliver Kim: Smoke checklist (short):
```
1) run curl to /v1/generate with canonical prompt set
2) verify output tokens per request sanity
3) check latency with `wrk` (p50/p95)
4) compare embedding similarity on regression set
```

QA-CI: CI smoke run preflight passed: 12/12 prompts within thresholds. Artifacts: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/boreal-preflight-2367.zip

Oliver Kim: On rollback — command to pin previous stable: `catalog pin boreal-3b --version v1.1 --slot 42` . I’ll be ready to run that if error >0.2% for 5m or latency p95>400ms.

Raj Chen: Timeline: 13:30 PT ops handoff, 14:00 PT canary start, 14:30 PT decision checkpoint, 15:00 PT full pin (if green).

Maya Patel: Sounds good. @Sasha can you keep an eye on audit logs and KMS key rotations during the window?

Sasha Rivera: Yep, I’ll watch audit stream and DM if anything unusual.

Raj Chen: I’ll post a short post-mortem thread if we hit any rollback. Otherwise I’ll update the catalog entry with the pinned version and rollout notes.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. Leave any final asks here. :thumbsup:
